sloka: ततः संपन्नम् इति उक्त्वा दत्त्वा हस्ते अवनेजनम् ।भ्रातरम् निष्क्रमस्व इति च इल्वलः समभाषत ॥३-११-६२॥
transliteration: tataḥ saṁpannam iti uktvā dattvā haste avanejanam ।bhrātaram niṣkramasva iti ca ilvalaḥ samabhāṣata ॥3-11-62॥

translations.english: Urged by the gods, Agastya came for the shradda . The mighty demon played the same routine trick and Vatapi, for sure, was eaten by the great sage.
